headline_finding.title: Metadata no-momentum census REJECTED-WITH-DATA — closes the detect-time entry-quality route
headline_finding.detail: Pre-registered lever from run #190 executed: 30d n=727, 14 stamped fields tested against ARMED(mfe>=0.40). momentum_state trending-vs-flat armed 59.9% vs 57.3% p=0.55. Numeric terciles (momentum_score/volume_spike/speed_percentile/price_acceleration) show FLAT armed% 54-62% across every bin; best gate p=0.119 with fk=66.7%. Structure fields (bb_position/z_score/macd_hist/gap_at_entry) p=0.44-0.82. staleness_minutes OPPOSITE direction (stale arms more) p=0.15. source-count single-vs-multi p=0.87. wave_phase accelerating n=297 has the LOWEST arm rate 55.2% and worst pnl -3.32 but fk would be 38%. rsi_drift gradient (high 71% wr) is n=30/cell, p=0.25, coverage 91/727 with stamped rows pre-selected better (+0.36 vs -3.75) = COLLECT only. Bonferroni bar 0.0036 — nothing survives. Combined with #96 admission-feature split, #190 chase-move (7% coverage) and impulse floor (rejected): there is NO detect-time metadata separator for arming.
headline_finding.implication: The 92.4% chop-bleed is not predictable from what we stamp. Route changed: stamp the ONE high-signal variable we never recorded (BTC EMA300 tape) and re-test; otherwise the remaining levers are exit-side (MFE-CUT shadow, due Nov 10) and signal-selection (arm-rate by family: all healthy >=48% except ai-trader-pending n=16).
